If DcmDspDataType is set to USE_DATA_SYNCH_FNC_PROXY, the following definition

[SWS_Dcm_91095]
Service Name
Xxx_WriteData (draft)
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Xxx_WriteData (
const uint8* Data,
uint16 DataLength,
Dcm_NegativeResponseCodeType* ErrorCode
)
Service ID [hex]
0x85
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Data
Buffer containing the data to be written
Parameters (in)
DataLength
Length in byte of the data to be written
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
ErrorCode
If the operation Xxx_WriteData returns value E_NOT_OK, the
DCM module shall send a negative response with NRC code
equal to the parameter ErrorCode parameter value.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Request was successful.
E_NOT_OK: Request was not successful.
Description
This function requests the application to write a data value of a DID if DcmDspDataUsePort is
set to USE_DATA_SYNCH_FNC_PROXY.
